Vektora does not bundle segmentation models. On first use of "Konuyu otomatik bul" it downloads
one of the following files into ~/.vektora/models after the user confirms, and verifies its size
and SHA-256 before use. The files are redistributed by the rembg project
(https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg, MIT License).

u2netp.onnx
  U²-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure for Salient Object Detection
  Xuebin Qin et al., https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
  License: Apache License 2.0

isnet-general-use.onnx
  Highly Accurate Dichotomous Image Segmentation (DIS / IS-Net)
  Xuebin Qin et al., https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS
  License: Apache License 2.0

The models run locally through ONNX Runtime (https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime,
MIT License). Images never leave the computer.

Apache License 2.0: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
